name: Weather
overview: Scripture reveals that weather is a divinely ordained and consistent part of creation, with cycles of seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, and seasons that will endure as long as the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). God controls the weather, providing rain in its proper season to bless the land and bring forth fruitfulness (Leviticus 26:4). The weather also demonstrates God's majesty and power, as seen in the shifting winds and fair weather described in Job 37, reminding us of His sovereign rule over nature. Believers are encouraged to look beyond the natural signs, trusting in God as their ultimate help amid changing conditions (Psalms 121:1).
